subject: [PATCH 0/2] crypto: zstd - avoid initializing the workspace twice

reviews.author: Usama Arif (author)
reviews.summary: Author inquired about the status of review, indicating no feedback or concerns were raised and reiterating that the optimization is still necessary.
sentiment_signals: author reiterated the need for the optimization
reviews.raw_body:
Hi,

Just wanted to check if there was any feedback or review of the series.

I think its a nice optimization and even with the CPUID instructions
getting cached [1], this is still needed. The improvement in baremetal
is not coming (just) from CPUID instructions.

[1] https://lore.kernel.org/all/20260901110850.1805747-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/

Thanks,
Usama

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch set avoids initializing the workspace twice in the zstd compression and decompression functions. The current implementation initializes the shared per-CPU workspace, but then immediately overwrites it without processing any bytes. This is optimized by deferring the stream initialization to the first iteration that actually streams, reducing overhead and improving performance.
